verdict.rationale: Inngest is an event-driven function platform: runs are triggered by events (child runs "triggered by another run via event"), webhook URLs turn third-party events from services like Stripe and GitHub into triggers, and rate limiting governs whether incoming events start functions. Cron schedules and step.waitForEvent() add time-based and conditional event handling, and community users describe it as a trigger solution that lets them "event everything." Rules are defined in code via the SDK rather than in a declarative rule builder. Missing for 10: explicit docs on event-trigger definitions and conditional/filter expressions in createFunction, any no-code or declarative rule configuration, and hands-on corroboration of complex trigger rules.
